name: A Grand Adventure

angles.text: As a Skyborne of Skywall, you face a great change. You leave your elemental home to seek salvation for Zephras Isle in Azeroth.

faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger asks for help as wind spirits vanish from Zephras Isle. The Windshapers believe saving their home means venturing beyond Skywall to Azeroth.
faq.q: What is the quest A Grand Adventure?

faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger is a Windshaper on Zephras Isle. She investigates the crisis and asks capable adventurers to heed what the Windshapers have learned.
Wind spirits have vanished from Zephras Isle without explanation. The Windshapers investigate the disturbances and seek a way to save their home.
faq.q: What crisis is taking place on Zephras Isle?

faq.answer: The Windshapers investigate the disturbances and missing wind spirits threatening Zephras Isle.
Ayessa Dawnsinger believes Skywall lacks the power and knowledge to save Zephras Isle. She believes they must seek salvation in Azeroth below.
faq.q: Why do the Windshapers need to travel to Azeroth?

faq.answer: Skywall is the elemental home realm of the Windshapers and Zephras Isle, above the mortal world of Azeroth.

sections.body: Wind spirits have vanished from Zephras Isle, and the trouble keeps growing. The Windshapers have investigated the disturbances and uncovered truths about their missing kin and the fate of their elemental home. Ayessa Dawnsinger asks you to heed what they have learned and prepare for an undertaking unlike any before.
sections.title: The Crisis on Zephras Isle

sections.body: Ayessa Dawnsinger believes Skywall lacks the power and knowledge to save Zephras Isle. She has concluded that salvation lies below, in the mortal world of Azeroth. Leaving their homeland breaks with tradition. The island's future depends on those willing to venture into the unknown.
sections.title: A Venture Beyond Skywall

summary: On Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger and the Windshapers seek a way to save their home. The isle lies in Skywall, where wind spirits have vanished without explanation.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Grand Adventure
